panels.description: Nexus, later: a tracked vehicle route marker stands far behind the coastal cave entrance. Roman arrives at one access point while Sitara and Nayah arrive at another; do not depict the access points as adjacent. Keep silent.
Inside Nexus beneath warped metal and blue ice, Sitara, Roman, and Nayah meet at a frozen threshold. Their separate TJs face one another. Leave upper corners clear.
Roman holds Orien’s chemical calibration sheet while Sitara holds the Falcon fragment. Their eyes stay on the documents, not each other. Leave upper third clear.
Nayah plants a route marker at the corridor entrance; a chalked arrow points back toward the exit. Leave upper-left clear.

items.speaker: ROMAN
items.text: This code is in your record.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Your record is the second half.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: We work inside the route. We leave when I say.
